title: Jeroboam I
subtitle: 1 Kings 12–14 | 22 yrs
description: First king of Northern Israel; set up golden calves at Dan and Bethel to prevent worship in Jerusalem.

title: Nadab
subtitle: 1 Kings 15 | 2 yrs
description: Son of Jeroboam I; assassinated by Baasha while besieging the Philistine town of Gibbethon.

title: Baasha
subtitle: 1 Kings 15–16 | 24 yrs
description: Wiped out Jeroboam's family; built Ramah to blockade Judah until King Asa bought Syrian aid.

title: Elah
subtitle: 1 Kings 16 | 2 yrs
description: Son of Baasha; assassinated while drunk by Zimri, commander of half his chariot force.

title: Zimri
subtitle: 1 Kings 16 | 7 days
description: Shortest reign in Israel; burned the royal palace down around himself when Omri besieged Tirzah.

title: Omri
subtitle: 1 Kings 16 | 12 yrs
description: Powerful military commander; established Samaria as capital of Northern Israel.

title: Ahab
subtitle: 1 Kings 16–22 | 22 yrs
description: Married Jezebel; made Baal state religion; opposed Elijah at Mt. Carmel; killed by random arrow at Ramoth-gilead.

title: Ahaziah
subtitle: 1 Kings 22 / 2 Kings 1 | 2 yrs
description: Fell through lattice in Samaria; consulted Baal-zebub; rebuked by Elijah.

title: Joram (Jehoram)
subtitle: 2 Kings 3–9 | 12 yrs
description: Fought Moab with Jehoshaphat; witnessed Elisha's ministry; assassinated by Jehu.

title: Jehu
subtitle: 2 Kings 9–10 | 28 yrs
description: Anointed by Elisha's messenger; executed Ahab's family and destroyed Baal worship, but kept Jeroboam's calf shrines.

title: Jehoahaz
subtitle: 2 Kings 13 | 17 yrs
description: Suffered severe military defeat under Hazael of Syria; prayed to God who provided temporary relief.

title: Jehoash (Joash)
subtitle: 2 Kings 13–14 | 16 yrs
description: Visited Elisha on his deathbed; defeated Amaziah of Judah and breached Jerusalem's wall.

title: Jeroboam II
subtitle: 2 Kings 14 | 41 yrs
description: Longest-reigning northern king; expanded Israel's borders to peak prosperity, but condemned by Amos for social injustice.

title: Zechariah
subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 6 months
description: Last of Jehu's dynasty; publicly assassinated by Shallum.

title: Shallum
subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 1 month
description: Reigned one month in Samaria before being overthrown and killed by Menahem.

title: Menahem
subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 10 yrs
description: Brutal usurper who paid heavy tribute to Pul (Tiglath-Pileser III) of Assyria by taxing wealthy Israelites.

title: Pekahiah
subtitle: 2 Kings 15 | 2 yrs
description: Son of Menahem; assassinated in Samaria citadel by his army officer Pekah.

title: Pekah
subtitle: 2 Kings 15–16 | 20 yrs
description: Allied with Syria against Judah (Syro-Ephraimite War); lost Galilee and Gilead to Assyria; assassinated by Hoshea.

title: Hoshea
subtitle: 2 Kings 17 | 9 yrs
description: Last king of Israel; stopped paying tribute to Assyria and sought Egyptian aid, leading to Samaria's fall and Northern Exile in 722 BC.
